integrity: All explicit polynomial identities were checked symbolically. Global scheme equality follows from a prime-ideal and dimension argument; computation alone does not certify it. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the dense open x2*x3*x7 != 0 of one singular plane is classified; other singular strata and intersections are not addressed. Possible implicit coverage by broader determinantal local-normal-form theorems is not ruled out.
title: A transverse cubic-Veronese quotient along a singular plane of the Han–Kwak fourfold
